title: Skylux Helicopters

services.name: Skylux Helicopters
services.desc: The Okanagan is home to world-class wineries and absolutely breathtaking scenery. From the hangar at YLW, you and your guests will be treated to the ultimate transportation in the AW119 Koala. Experience the mountains, lakes and vineyards from an aerial perspective. Throughout the valley, there are many wineries that have heli-landing pads. Many of these vineyards also offer exceptional dining options. Additionally, you’ll be invited to tour some of the finest vineyards, taste award winning wines and do so in style!
